scenarios.name: floor
scenarios.about: Terrain bitmap only: what the browser costs before any scene.

scenarios.name: spec-1x
scenarios.about: The R0 scene by the letter at the display's resolution: every plant a sprite.

scenarios.name: spec-still
scenarios.about: The R0 scene with no creatures: nothing moves, so nothing is rebuilt.

scenarios.name: spec-apart
scenarios.about: The R0 scene with the plants drawn apart: creatures walk over them, not among.

scenarios.name: spec-2x
scenarios.about: The same scene drawn at 512×300 and scaled up: art pixels of 2 screen pixels.

scenarios.name: spec-4x
scenarios.about: The same scene drawn at 256×150: art pixels of 4 screen pixels.

scenarios.name: map-1x
scenarios.about: A wide shot as it would ship: plants as a flat map, sprites kept for close-ups.

scenarios.name: close-1x
scenarios.about: A panning close-up at full resolution, off-screen plants skipped.

scenarios.name: close-2x
scenarios.about: The same close-up at 512×300.

scenarios.name: crowd-1x
scenarios.about: Every creature the sim can hold, animated at once.

scenarios.name: map-view
scenarios.about: The map view: painted ground, every creature a dot.

scenarios.name: mid-view
scenarios.about: The middle view: painted ground, the plants that stand, 50 creatures.

scenarios.name: mid-crowd
scenarios.about: The middle view with every creature the sim can hold walking somewhere.

scenarios.name: local-view
scenarios.about: The local view: the camera on one creature, ground painted as it goes.
